links.outcome: Whether decision-time reliability signals identify cases to handle autonomously versus defer for review
links.effect: At a consistency threshold of 0.90, 49.4% of cases were retained at 98.9% diagnostic accuracy; remaining cases deferred for review.
links.quote: At a consistency threshold of 0.90, 49.4% of cases were retained at 98.9% diagnostic accuracy.

links.outcome: Discrimination of diagnostic correctness by internal-likelihood, language-based and behavioral-consistency uncertainty measures
links.effect: Diagnostic behavioral consistency gave the strongest discrimination of correctness (AUC = 0.860) and remained informative under stress testing (AUC = 0.875).
links.quote: Diagnostic behavioral consistency provided the strongest discrimination of correctness (area under the curve (AUC) = 0.860) and remained informative under stress testing (AUC = 0.875).

screen.reason: Evaluates a reliability/uncertainty threshold framework (selective autonomy/deferral of uncertain cases) on MIMIC-IV benchmark tasks for an autonomous clinical AI agent.
